blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Former Public Works-Bulacan District Engineer Henry Alcantara has returned another batch of cold cash to the Bureau of Treasury, increasing the pot to P866.4 million. Justice Undersecretary Deo Marco made the revelation on Thursday, noting that the stolen public funds have been recently turned over to the Bureau of Treasury (BTr). Marco added that the recovered assets are not only money, but also properties and assets that were frozen. “And as investigations continue, there are more properties being discovered. So it’s just continuing,” Marco told reporters. The amount also covers cases only from alleged irregularities of infrastructure projects in Bulacan. […]...
